title: Norm EN 1990/1991 Feature Completeness
description: Implement Norm feature completeness in norm/en/1990/rs/lib.rs and norm/en/1991/rs/lib.rs: expand design basis checks, check_full_actions, Document fields, numeric tests.
summary: Expanded EN 1990 design basis to cover persistent, accidental, and seismic combination sets; evaluate() now runs persistent + accidental with reliability; removed dead LimitState line; added numeric accidental evaluate test. EN 1991 gained check_full_actions() across parts 1-1–1-7 and 2–4 with structural wind factor c_s·c_d, expanded Document fields, evaluate() wired to check_full_actions, and replaced weak e2e test with numeric assertions. All 16 unit tests pass.
